image.description: The collector image, pinned by digest in the bundle's shape.
image.x-cybercloud-internal-reason: Upstream's contrib distribution, unmodified. ⚠ `repository:tag@sha256:…` — the shape every charts/bundle component records its images in — and the same string as MonitorCollectors.Image; CollectorDeclarationTests fails when the two drift. Resolved 2026-09-17; SOURCE has the command and the output. A tenant choosing what runs in a pod that holds their workspace's ingest key is not a configuration surface.

receivers.description: Which OTLP protocols the collector listens on. At least one; both is the default.

otlpGrpc.description: Accept OTLP over gRPC on port 4317 — what most SDKs send by default.

otlpHttp.description: Accept OTLP over HTTP on port 4318 — protobuf or JSON, for browsers and anything that cannot speak gRPC.

replicas.description: How many collector pods share the endpoint. The collector is stateless, so more replicas is more fan-in and nothing else.

sizing.description: CPU and memory for each collector pod.

preset.description: How much each pod gets. The small row carries a few thousand spans a second; the larger rows are for a whole cluster's telemetry through one gateway. The memory limiter is set from the preset, so an oversized burst is refused rather than killed.
